$comment: W3-09: every default-profile service of docker-compose.v9.yml (no `profiles:` key) is either a workload of the same name in helm/sahool/values.yaml or an entry under `excluded` here, with a category and a written reason. For each workload, every container variable compose marks required (${NAME:?...}) is rendered by its env or secretEnv, or is excused under `env_excused` with a reason. Enforced by scripts/ci/helm_compose_workload_guard.py: a compose service in neither list, a stale entry (a service that now has a workload or that compose no longer runs), an unrendered required variable, or a stale excuse all block. The ledger shrinks as services are ported; an entry is a recorded decision, not a waiver of the variable or service it names.

categories.one_shot_job: A container that runs to completion once (seed, init, model pull). Not a Deployment; the chart either runs it as a Job (sahool-migrate -> jobs.migration) or leaves it to the operator.
categories.tls_init: Generates self-signed TLS material for a compose-local peer. In a cluster, TLS comes from the platform's certificate manager or the managed service, not from an init container.
categories.chart_component: Deployed by the chart under another template, not under `workloads`.
categories.stateful_infrastructure: A database, cache, broker or object store. Needs a StatefulSet with persistence, backups and its own credentials; the chart expects it to be provided (managed service or a separate chart) and reaches it through secret DSNs.
categories.observability: Metrics, tracing or dashboards. Provided by the cluster's monitoring stack (the chart sets prometheus.io annotations and observability.*), not deployed by this chart.
categories.edge_device: Runs on field hardware, not in the cluster.
categories.not_yet_ported: An application service or worker the chart does not deploy yet. The reason names what porting needs.

raster-tiler-service.reason: TiTiler COG tiler that sahool-platform reaches through TITILER_URL (default http://raster-tiler-service:8088). The chart's platform workload sets no TITILER_URL, so porting needs the workload, a Service of that name and the platform variable together.

sahool-nginx-tls-init.reason: Writes a self-signed certificate for the compose gateway. The chart's Ingress terminates TLS with ingress.tlsSecretName.

sahool-nginx.reason: The compose gateway. The chart deploys its equivalent as sahool-gateway from templates/gateway.yaml with files/gateway/ (W0-06), not as a workload.

sahool-video-processor.reason: Needs MQTT credentials and the MQTT broker (sahool-fastbee), Redis and the edge and field-service tenant assertion keys; none of those are deployed or referenced by the chart.

sahool-agriai-engine.reason: Not routed by the chart gateway and not called by any chart workload yet; porting needs its gateway route and SAHOOL_AGENT_TOKEN wiring.

sahool-tts-service.reason: Needs REDIS_URL (Redis is not deployed by the chart) and a gateway route; no chart workload calls it.

sahool-postgres-tls-init.reason: Writes the compose Postgres server certificate. The chart's databases are external; their TLS is set in the DSN secrets.

sahool-postgres.reason: PostGIS database. The chart reaches it through global.secretRefs.databaseUrl and jobsDatabaseUrl; a StatefulSet with persistence, backups and role bootstrap is out of W3-09's reach.

sahool-redis.reason: Cache Redis with per-service ACL users (docs/architecture/redis_acl_matrix.json). The chart takes each service's Redis URL as a secret (redisUrl, agentRedisUrl and the ones added by W3-09); deploying Redis with those ACL users is out of W3-09's reach.

sahool-redis-state.reason: State Redis (auth revocation, lockout, agent store) with ACL users. Provided outside the chart; reached through the secret URLs.

sahool-nats-tls-init.reason: Writes the compose NATS server certificate. Not needed by the chart, which does not deploy NATS.

sahool-nats.reason: JetStream broker with per-identity passwords (nats/nats.conf). A StatefulSet with JetStream persistence and those identities is out of W3-09's reach; until NATS is provided the workers that need it stay unported.

sahool-minio.reason: S3-compatible object store. Provided outside the chart (managed S3 or a separate chart); sahool-raster-service stores COGs on its ReadWriteMany volume instead.

sahool-minio-init.reason: Creates the compose buckets and the per-service MinIO users. Belongs to whichever object store is provided.

sahool-qdrant.reason: Vector database for sahool-rag-retrieval. Needs a StatefulSet with persistence and an API key; out of W3-09's reach.

sahool-ollama-models.reason: Pulls Ollama models into the compose volume once.

sahool-ollama.reason: Local model server with a model volume and, for useful latency, a GPU node; not deployable as a plain chart workload.

sahool-migrate.reason: The chart runs the same migrator image as the pre-install/pre-upgrade Job in templates/migration-job.yaml (jobs.migration).

sahool-weather-signal-engine.reason: Background engine that needs both DATABASE_URL and JOBS_DATABASE_URL; the chart's jobsDatabaseUrl secret holds the migration owner DSN (values.yaml jobs.migration), not a sahool_jobs DSN, so porting needs that secret split first.

sahool-supervisor-agent.reason: Calls sahool-platform on the platform-internal channel, which needs PLATFORM_TENANT_ASSERTION_KEY on both sides; the chart wires it on neither (see env_excused.sahool-platform).

sahool-sentinel-hub-mcp.reason: MCP server that needs Sentinel Hub credentials (SH_CLIENT_ID/SH_CLIENT_SECRET) the chart does not declare.

sahool-weather-mcp.reason: MCP server in front of sahool-weather-service. Porting it also means adding it to weather-service's internalCallers, which admit sahool-platform only.

sahool-wofost-mcp.reason: MCP server not called by any chart workload yet.

sahool-market-mcp.reason: MCP server not called by any chart workload yet.

sahool-vegetation-analysis.reason: Assessed under W3-09 and left out: compose requires NATS_URL with a TLS CA mounted at /etc/sahool/nats-ca, and the chart deploys no NATS and has no CA mount; its anomaly store defaults to per-pod SQLite, which needs one replica on a volume, while production requires two replicas, and the multi-replica Postgres store is opt-in until certified (anomaly_runtime.py). A workload would either fail the production replica rule or split anomalies between pods.

sahool-field-management.reason: Owner of field_tasks. Porting needs its DSN, the service token, the field-service tenant assertion key and its assertion replay Redis.

sahool-scout-ingest.reason: Assessed under W3-09 and left out: every feature flag defaults off, and its public routes (/api/v1/scouting-media/, /api/v1/seasons) need the gateway to inject service tokens (X-Scout-Media-Token, X-Season-Entry-Token) and an edge attestation from auth. The chart gateway's configuration is a ConfigMap with no secret injection, and compose requires S3 credentials for an object store the chart does not deploy. A workload would serve nothing reachable.

sahool-scout-ingest-projection.reason: Projection worker of scout-ingest; follows sahool-scout-ingest.

sahool-remote-sensing-workspace-bff.reason: Aggregates indicators, vegetation and decision services; indicators and vegetation are not deployed by the chart.

sahool-raster-cache-invalidation-worker.reason: Needs REDIS_URL, S3 credentials and JOBS_DATABASE_URL; the chart provides none of the three for raster workers.

sahool-raster-backfill-scan-worker.reason: Needs REDIS_URL, S3 credentials and JOBS_DATABASE_URL; the chart provides none of the three for raster workers.

sahool-indicators-service.reason: The compose gateway sends /api/indicators/ to sahool-platform; the service itself is called by vegetation and the workspace BFF, neither deployed by the chart.

sahool-actuator-service.reason: Physical-effect service: needs the MQTT broker, MQTT credentials and the auth revocation Redis (DENYLIST_REDIS_URL), none deployed or referenced by the chart.

sahool-fastbee.reason: Mosquitto MQTT broker with credentials and persistence; provided outside the chart.

sahool-edge.reason: Built from services/edge-inference/Dockerfile.arm64 for the field device; it syncs to the platform over the edge channel.

sahool-local-ai-rag.reason: Needs Qdrant (QDRANT_API_KEY), which the chart does not deploy.

sahool-qdrant-seed.reason: Seeds the Qdrant collection once; follows sahool-qdrant.

sahool-telegram-bot.reason: Needs a public webhook route and TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET plus Redis; the chart gateway has no such route.

sahool-notification-agent.reason: Needs NATS and Redis, and serves the /ws/ WebSocket the chart gateway does not route.

sahool-frontend.reason: The web shell. The chart gateway routes only API prefixes; serving the shell needs a gateway location for / and a workload for the frontend image.

sahool-prometheus.reason: The cluster's Prometheus scrapes the chart's pods through the prometheus.io annotations (observability.prometheusScrape).

sahool-alertmanager.reason: Provided by the cluster's monitoring stack.

sahool-grafana.reason: Provided by the cluster's monitoring stack; the chart names the dashboards ConfigMap in observability.grafanaDashboardConfigMap.

sahool-jaeger.reason: Tracing backend; provided by the cluster's monitoring stack.

sahool-field-segmentation.reason: Not routed by the chart gateway and not called by any chart workload yet.

sahool-phase-runtime-outbox-worker.reason: Platform worker that needs NATS_URL and a sahool_jobs JOBS_DATABASE_URL; the chart deploys no NATS and its jobsDatabaseUrl secret is the migration owner DSN.

sahool-plugin-runtime-worker.reason: Platform worker that needs NATS_URL and a sahool_jobs JOBS_DATABASE_URL; the chart deploys no NATS and its jobsDatabaseUrl secret is the migration owner DSN.

sahool-model-registry-worker.reason: Platform worker that needs NATS_URL and a sahool_jobs JOBS_DATABASE_URL; the chart deploys no NATS and its jobsDatabaseUrl secret is the migration owner DSN.

sahool-water-ledger-worker.reason: Platform worker that needs a sahool_jobs JOBS_DATABASE_URL; the chart's jobsDatabaseUrl secret is the migration owner DSN.

sahool-actuator-dispatch-worker.reason: Physical-effect worker that needs NATS_URL and a sahool_jobs JOBS_DATABASE_URL; neither is available in the chart.

sahool-zlmediakit-config.reason: Renders the ZLMediaKit configuration once for the media server.

sahool-zlmediakit.reason: RTSP/RTMP media server with UDP ports and a pinned image digest supplied at deploy time (ZLMEDIAKIT_IMAGE); not a plain HTTP workload.

sahool-canonical-execution-learning-work.reason: Platform worker that needs NATS_URL; the chart deploys no NATS.

sahool-nats-exporter.reason: Exporter for the compose NATS; follows sahool-nats.

sahool-nginx-exporter.reason: Exporter for the compose gateway; the cluster's ingress controller has its own metrics.

sahool-pg-exporter.reason: Exporter for the compose Postgres; follows sahool-postgres.

sahool-otel-collector.reason: OpenTelemetry collector; provided by the cluster's monitoring stack.

sahool-decision-service.reason: Called by sahool-platform at DECISION_SERVICE_URL (default http://sahool-decision-service:8160). In production it refuses to start without DECISION_SERVICE_AUTH_TOKEN, and the platform needs the same token as DECISION_SERVICE_TOKEN.

sahool-auth.JWT_SECRET: HS256 signing secret. The workload signs RS256 with JWT_PRIVATE_KEY/JWT_PUBLIC_KEY, which it renders; with a private key set auth needs no JWT_SECRET (services/auth/main.py:323-326), and production refuses HS256 (main.py:337-346). Its other use, the MFA audit-hash fallback, is covered by MFA_AUDIT_HASH_KEY (services/auth/mfa_runtime.py:43).

sahool-platform.JWT_SECRET: HS256 secret. In production the platform verifies RS256 with JWT_PUBLIC_KEY, which the workload renders (services/sahool-platform/api/main.py:129-141); HS256 is only the SAHOOL_ALLOW_HS256_IN_PROD migration escape, which the chart does not set.
sahool-platform.SAHOOL_JWT_SECRET: Same HS256 secret under the platform's name (services/sahool-platform/api/main.py:129); not used while JWT_PUBLIC_KEY is set.
sahool-platform.DENYLIST_REDIS_URL: Falls back to REDIS_URL (services/sahool-platform/core/jwt_denylist.py:47), which the workload renders. The sahool-redis-url secret must therefore point at the Redis server auth writes revocations to (sahool-auth-redis-url); compose keeps them on separate ACL users.
sahool-platform.JOBS_DATABASE_URL: Not ported: the chart's jobsDatabaseUrl secret holds the migration owner DSN (values.yaml jobs.migration), not a sahool_jobs DSN. Without it the platform's jobs pool falls back to DATABASE_URL (services/sahool-platform/api/main.py:267).
sahool-platform.NATS_URL: Not ported: the chart deploys no NATS. The outbox relay defaults to nats://sahool-nats:4222 and keeps retrying (services/sahool-platform/api/main.py:550); events stay in the outbox until a broker is provided.
sahool-platform.PLATFORM_TENANT_ASSERTION_KEY: Not ported: the platform-internal channel's callers (ai_agronomist, supervisor-agent; services/sahool-platform/api/service_token_auth.py:87-92) are unwired in the chart; without the key the channel refuses (fail closed).
sahool-platform.PLATFORM_TENANT_ASSERTION_REDIS_URL: Not ported with the key above; in production a missing replay store answers 503 (services/sahool-platform/api/service_token_auth.py:112-116).
sahool-platform.EDGE_TENANT_ASSERTION_KEY: Not ported: sahool-edge runs on field hardware; without the key the edge proxy answers 503 (services/sahool-platform/api/routers/service_proxy.py:284-286).
sahool-platform.EDGE_SYNC_TENANT_ASSERTION_KEY: Not ported: the edge-sync channel (services/sahool-platform/api/service_token_auth.py:94-99) has no caller in the cluster.

sahool-raster-service.REDIS_URL: Not ported: the chart deploys no Redis for raster. The job store then keeps jobs in process memory (services/raster-service/job_store.py:56-73), so with several replicas a job is visible only on the pod that created it.
sahool-raster-service.S3_ACCESS_KEY: The chart stores COGs on the ReadWriteMany volume at /data/rasters (persistence); with S3 unconfigured the object store writes file:// paths (services/raster-service/object_store.py:30-40). Moving raster to S3 is separate work.
sahool-raster-service.S3_SECRET_KEY: Same as S3_ACCESS_KEY: the chart's raster storage is the persistent volume, not S3.

sahool-ai-agronomist.PLATFORM_TENANT_ASSERTION_KEY: Not ported (see sahool-platform). Without it the field evidence call reports unavailable instead of failing (services/ai_agronomist/ai_evidence_runtime.py:135, 233).

sahool-rag-retrieval.QDRANT_API_KEY: Not ported: the chart deploys no Qdrant (see excluded.sahool-qdrant); the key belongs with that deployment.

sahool-guardrails-engine.REDIS_URL: Compose sets it, but no module under services/guardrails-engine reads REDIS_URL or imports a helper that does (grep, 2026-11-16); rendering it would hand the pod a credential it never uses.
